original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚贝努埃州警方解救天主教神父及七名被绑人员
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚贝努埃州警察局在奥希米尼地方政府区解救了一名天主教神父约翰·奥塔切及另外七名被绑架人员。警方发言人表示，救援行动中逮捕了两名嫌疑人。据称，这名神父与七名受害者上周二在从村庄市场返回途中被绑架。目前信息来自单一来源。

location.raw_text: Ohimini Local Government Area, Benue State

key_facts.fact: 贝努埃州警方解救了包括天主教神父约翰·奥塔切在内的八名被绑架人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Benue State Police Command has rescued eight kidnap victims, including the Catholic priest of Otukpo Diocese, Rev. Fr. John Otache.

key_facts.fact: 救援行动中逮捕了两名嫌疑人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: two suspects were arrested during the rescue operation

key_facts.fact: 神父与七名受害者上周二在从村庄市场返回途中被绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Catholic priest and the seven victims were kidnapped last Tuesday while returning from a village market along the Ugbokolo–Ajegbe–Awume Road, before Ipiga Village in the Ohimini Local Government Area

uncertainties: 目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
被绑架的具体细节及嫌疑人身份尚未获独立确认
